roles.name: Practice Lead
roles.description: Owns positioning, methodology and commercial terms.

roles.name: Lead Business Analyst
roles.description: Runs elicitation, specification and deliverable production on an engagement.

roles.name: Facilitator
roles.description: Delivers courses, workshops and study sessions.

roles.name: Engagement Sponsor
roles.description: Client-side owner who funds the work and accepts deliverables.

roles.name: Marketing Lead
roles.description: Owns brand, content and campaign execution.

roles.name: Platform Engineer
roles.description: Builds and operates the BAS platform.

roles.name: Practice Administrator
roles.description: Handles enrolment, invoicing, records and vendor admin.

valueStreams.name: Client Need to Realised Benefit
valueStreams.trigger: A market signal or client need is identified
valueStreams.valueProposition: A client capability gap is closed with traceable, assured business analysis, and the practice gains reusable IP.

stages.name: Attract & Qualify
stages.entryState: Market signal or unqualified need exists
stages.exitState: Qualified opportunity with an agreed scope
stages.outcome: Demand is qualified against the service portfolio before effort is spent on a proposal.
metrics: Time from first contact to qualification

stages.name: Propose & Contract
stages.exitState: Signed SOW with terms set and a named delivery team
stages.outcome: Scope, price and capacity are agreed before delivery is committed.

stages.name: Mobilise
stages.exitState: Engagement plan agreed, stakeholders mapped, methodology and tooling in place
stages.outcome: The engagement starts against a known method, a mapped stakeholder set and agreed AI usage boundaries.
metrics: Days from signature to first working session

stages.name: Analyse & Specify
stages.exitState: Traceable requirements and evaluated options accepted by the client
stages.outcome: The client's need is expressed as specified, traceable requirements with options evaluated against them.

stages.name: Deliver & Assure
stages.exitState: Reviewed deliverables handed over and accepted
stages.outcome: Deliverables meet practice standards and are formally accepted.

stages.name: Realise & Reinvest
stages.exitState: Benefits assessed, invoice settled, reusable IP captured back into the practice
stages.outcome: Client value is evidenced, revenue is collected, and the engagement leaves behind reusable practice IP.

valueStreams.name: Learner Interest to Capability Applied
valueStreams.trigger: A practitioner or employer identifies a capability gap
valueStreams.valueProposition: A practitioner gains a demonstrable, certified BA capability they apply in their own work, and the practice gains a community and a feedback loop.

stages.name: Attract & Enrol
stages.entryState: Practitioner or employer has a capability gap
stages.exitState: Paid enrolment confirmed in a scheduled cohort
stages.outcome: Interest becomes a confirmed, paid seat in a dated cohort.
metrics: Cohort fill rate at T-14 days

stages.name: Prepare
stages.exitState: Courseware, platform and facilitator ready for delivery
stages.outcome: Every cohort starts from current courseware on a working platform with a briefed facilitator.

stages.name: Deliver
stages.outcome: Learners complete the scheduled sessions with support available throughout.

stages.name: Assess & Certify
stages.outcome: Capability is demonstrated and evidenced rather than assumed from attendance.
metrics: Days from final session to certificate issue

stages.name: Sustain & Improve
stages.exitState: Feedback captured, curriculum updated, learner active in the community
stages.outcome: Each cohort makes the next one better, and alumni become a demand channel.
